rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account and looked up the order and product variants. However, they performed order-changing writes (exchanges) without first obtaining explicit confirmation to proceed, as required by policy. The user merely selected desired replacements; the agent should have restated the exact changes and requested confirmation before submitting the exchange. Because no confirmation was requested, this also violated the user’s stated preference to only exchange the desk lamp if asked for confirmation. Additionally, the agent did not verify order status/eligibility before using the delivered-order exchange tool, and later asserted that the exchange could not be changed or canceled without any supporting tool check. These issues fail the pass bar despite correct identity verification and item lookup.
